Finding the right pair of gym leggings comes down to what kind of sweat session you're tackling. Top-rated options break down best by your primary workout style and budget:

### **Top Picks by Workout Type** 

- **Best for Strength Training & Heavy Lifting:** [Lululemon Wunder Train High-Rise Tight](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462916887206827,imageDocid:17757021806814320319,gpcid:401585924658474233,headlineOfferDocid:7224685329776558721,catalogid:1460226772683696129,productDocid:8330070587426478508,rds:PC_401585924658474233%7CPROD_PC_401585924658474233&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiYy73b64OYAxVSHxAIHWyhCqkQxa4PeggIAggBCBIQAw) ($98)
	- *Why we love them:* Made from fast-drying *Everlux* fabric, they feel cool and supportive, won't slide down during squats, and handle heavy barbell friction like a champ.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-leggings/)[[2]](https://thatfitfriend.com/best-workout-leggings/)
- **Best for Yoga, Pilates & Lounging:** [CRZ Yoga Butterluxe Legging](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462567380744354,imageDocid:5255067966147313043,gpcid:2675575851685768920,headlineOfferDocid:17820713564804315091,catalogid:5153439427724023993,productDocid:10991741420142581032,rds:PC_2675575851685768920%7CPROD_PC_2675575851685768920&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiYy73b64OYAxVSHxAIHWyhCqkQxa4PeggIAggBCBIQCw) ($32)
	- *Why we love them:* A massive fan-favorite budget alternative to ultra-soft luxury brands; they feel weightless, brushed, and supremely flexible without squeezing too hard.[[1]](https://thatfitfriend.com/best-workout-leggings/)
- **Best Compression & Eco-Friendly Pick:** [Girlfriend Collective Compressive Legging](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,imageDocid:11114914698205688184,headlineOfferDocid:5987650083577218446,productDocid:5987650083577218446,rds:PC_10606002224833084386%7CPROD_PC_10606002224833084386&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiYy73b64OYAxVSHxAIHWyhCqkQxa4PeggIAggBCBIQEw) ($79)
	- *Why we love them:* Spun from recycled water bottles with an inclusive size range (XXS to 6XL), offering a firm, high-rise hold that stays locked in place.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-leggings/)
- **Best for Running & Cardio:** [Lululemon Fast and Free Tight](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462913724382761,imageDocid:11045371982200461960,gpcid:80079623124325426,headlineOfferDocid:7001794076597055573,catalogid:6475388165896664052,productDocid:1438253986801155263,rds:PC_80079623124325426%7CPROD_PC_80079623124325426&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiYy73b64OYAxVSHxAIHWyhCqkQxa4PeggIAggBCBIQGw) ($128)
	- *Why we love them:* Featherlight, sweat-wicking, and equipped with drop-in pockets that actually keep your phone from bouncing around on miles 1 through 10.[[1]](https://thatfitfriend.com/best-workout-leggings/)
- **Best Squat-Proof & Sleek Feel:** [Alo Airlift Legging](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462575578819949,imageDocid:1151572733106908657,gpcid:8233364842916458104,headlineOfferDocid:2454647789168335605,catalogid:15564746662137192955,productDocid:14958786067500533143,rds:PC_15809957987340809162%7CPROD_PC_15809957987340809162&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiYy73b64OYAxVSHxAIHWyhCqkQxa4PeggIAggBCBIQIw) ($134)
	- *Why we love them:* Features a cool-to-the-touch, micro-performance double-knit fabric that delivers serious lift and zero transparency.[[1]](https://thatfitfriend.com/best-workout-leggings/)
- **Best Budget Pick:** [Colorfulkoala Dreamlux Legging](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462853409689658,imageDocid:5732918998591228036,gpcid:6839921096357286712,headlineOfferDocid:9896186709481138947,catalogid:12656601233005177949,productDocid:17918625029708093552,rds:PC_6839921096357286712%7CPROD_PC_6839921096357286712&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiYy73b64OYAxVSHxAIHWyhCqkQxa4PeggIAggBCBIQKw) ($32)
	- *Why we love them:* Buttery soft, contouring seams, and impressive opacity that rivals pairs triple the price tag.[[1]](https://thatfitfriend.com/best-workout-leggings/)
- **Best Extended & Plus Size:** [Superfit Hero Superhold Ankle / Pocket Leggings](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462892685451928,imageDocid:10941839297681872690,gpcid:12853291147274374038,headlineOfferDocid:15007902569417420274,catalogid:3542998591367798011,productDocid:16938016721217393502,rds:PC_12853291147274374038%7CPROD_PC_12853291147274374038&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiYy73b64OYAxVSHxAIHWyhCqkQxa4PeggIAggBCBIQMw) 
	- *Why we love them:* Specifically engineered for extended sizes (L through 7XL) with a thick, supportive, non-rolling waistband that survives intense workouts and spin classes.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-leggings/)[[2]](https://superfithero.com/blogs/news/wirecutter-by-ny-times-the-best-leggings)

To narrow this down, tell me:

- What **type of workouts** do you do most (e.g., heavy lifting, running, HIIT, yoga)?
- Do you prefer a **high-compression (tight/snuck)** or **butter-soft (weightless)** feel?
- Are you looking for **side pockets**?
